body.name: Q_stab
body.def: \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\) is the set of disjoint \(A,B\subseteq V_0\) for which \(\mathfrak F_{A,B}(P_X)\neq\varnothing\) and the set \(\{\operatorname*{ess\,sup}_{x\sim P_{X_A}}\operatorname{rank}Dg(x):g\in\mathfrak F_{A,B}(P_X)\}\) is a singleton; pairs with an empty argument are included with value zero.
